FACT_ID: SEC09-F01 | anchor: A01
Flex lane use is controlled by overhead signals with green arrow meaning allowed and red X meaning prohibited.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F02 | anchor: A01
Freeway travel calls for keeping a following gap, never making U-turns, and never driving or stopping for passengers in the emergency lane outside the solid white edge line.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F03 | anchor: A02
Express lanes on the described corridor serve vehicles with at least two occupants free plus eligible motorcycles, buses, and registered clean-fuel decal vehicles.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F04 | anchor: A02
Crossing a double white line is prohibited, so express lane entry and exit occur only at dotted-line access points.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F05 | anchor: A02
Single-occupant use of express lanes needs a purchased pass with an active funded account read by windshield transponder.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F06 | anchor: A01
A vehicle in the left lane of a multi-lane highway that is approached from behind must move right safely to avoid impeding traffic and citation.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F07 | anchor: A03
Join a multi-lane highway by using the acceleration lane to match speed, finding a gap, merging, then cancelling the signal.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F08 | anchor: A03
Leave the roadway by moving to the exit lane early, holding main-road speed, signaling, shifting to the deceleration lane, slowing, and cancelling the signal.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F09 | anchor: A04
Ramp meters show alternating red and green and generally admit one vehicle per green when metering is announced by a lighted meter-on sign.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F10 | anchor: A05
Runaway vehicle ramps are for emergency stopping need only, with stopping, standing, or parking on them or their path prohibited.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F11 | anchor: A06
At a single-point urban interchange a U-turn from the off-ramp to re-enter is allowed facing a green arrow, completed without stopping mid-intersection, and power loss is not treated as a four-way stop.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F12 | anchor: A07
Intersection approach calls for slowing, searching controls and users, full stop behind signs, signals, sidewalks, lines, no lane change inside, and left-right-left check before moving.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F13 | anchor: A08
Shared center left-turn lane entry is limited in distance before the turn and follows mirror, signal, blind-spot, smooth entry, then turn when clear.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F14 | anchor: A09
Signal meanings include go with caution on green, yield-then-go on green arrow, prepare to stop on yellow, stop-and-stay on red and red arrows, with right on red after full stop unless posted otherwise.
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F15 | anchor: A10
Right-of-way is yielded to the vehicle already at the intersection, oncoming traffic on left turns, the driver on the right at simultaneous four-way stops, traffic on the public road, traffic already on the interstate, and users still in the intersection.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: SEC09-F16 | anchor: A09
Flashing yellow allows cautious passage while flashing red calls for stop then look both ways, and officer directions override any light.
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

Misconceptions: left lane is for cruising; crosswalk protection needs paint; yellow means speed up; double white may be crossed to exit quickly.

Mnemonics: Green-Go, Yellow-Yield-to-stop, Red-Rest; Left-Look, Right-Respect, Through-Take-care.
